_note: 2026-10-17: no verifiable ground photo available; a labelled Esri World Imagery satellite view of the airport is published instead.

agx-sat-1.webp.zh: 卫星视角：阿加蒂机场的跑道铺在拉克沙群岛的狭长小岛上，航站楼与机坪在跑道一侧，四周是潟湖与珊瑚礁。
agx-sat-1.webp.en: Satellite view: Agatti's runway lies on a narrow Lakshadweep island, with the terminal and apron alongside it and lagoon and reef around.

agx-doubao-01.webp.zh: 视频截图：从低空看阿加蒂机场的跑道贴着狭长小岛铺展，两侧是绿松石色潟湖与白色浪花。
agx-doubao-01.webp.en: Video still: a low approach to Agatti's runway, which hugs a narrow island between turquoise lagoon and white surf.

agx-doubao-02.webp.zh: 空中俯瞰：阿加蒂机场的跑道几乎占满这座细长小岛，四周浅滩呈青绿色，远处是深蓝海水。
agx-doubao-02.webp.en: Aerial view: Agatti's runway fills almost the whole slender island, ringed by pale green shallows that fall away into deep blue ocean.

agx-doubao-03.webp.zh: 一架客机低空掠过绿松石色潟湖，对准阿加蒂机场的跑道进近，跑道尽头是机坪与低矮房屋。
agx-doubao-03.webp.en: An airliner skims low over the turquoise lagoon on final approach to Agatti's runway, with the apron and low buildings at its end.

agx-doubao-04.webp.zh: 黄昏时分的航拍：阿加蒂机场的跑道沿着窄岛一直伸向海平面，两侧沙滩外是平静的礁湖。
agx-doubao-04.webp.en: At dusk an aerial view follows Agatti's runway stretching along the narrow island toward the horizon, calm reef water beyond beaches on both sides.
